data.name: Bhavesh
data.gender_notes: Bhavesh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Lord of the world; lord of existence
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit bhava, 'existence, world', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the world'. Its root is Sanskrit bhava + īśa. A classical Sanskrit name. Bhavesh is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of the world; lord of existence”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bhavesh expresses “Lord of the world; lord of existence”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit bhava, 'existence, world', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the world'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhavesh total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
